channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: More than 100,000 displaced as they flee violence in Yemen: UN
item.description: Thousands making risky maritime journey to Djibouti as conflict between Yemen gov't and Houthis intensifies.

item.title: Can China play peacemaker as Iran’s foreign minister heads to Beijing?
item.description: Tehran and Beijing explore diplomatic paths amid escalating tensions between Iran and the United States.

item.title: Canada, the UK and Australia should investigate the WCK attack in Gaza
item.description: Israel has made clear it is unwilling to hold to account those responsible for the deaths of seven humanitarian workers.

item.title: Saudi Arabia faces high-stakes choices as war with Houthis escalates
item.description: Riyadh has several military options, say analysts, but all of them carry risks, too.

item.title: Can the Houthis hold on to Yemen’s strategic western coast?
item.description: Houthi coastal advances face hurdles: geography, local resistance and fierce government counterattacks.

item.title: Houthi-run TV releases video of abandoned Mocha airport
item.description: Houthi-run TV has aired drone video of Yemen’s Mocha International Airport, empty and abandoned.

item.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
item.description: Iran says El Gaia caught fire after hitting mines, but the US says the oil tanker was struck by a missile and then a drone.

item.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
item.description: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".
